items.text: Bills ruled out WR DJ Moore due to a shoulder injury sustained diving in end zone during TNF vs Lions; also had stinger, X-rays, walked off but ruled out.
items.why: Landed hard on shoulder attempting catch; questionable to return then ruled out.
items.implication: Removes BUF WR from Week 2 (TNF already played); elevates other Bills pass-catchers short-term.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for remaining BUF WRs/TEs in remaining games if lingering.

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) DNP Thursday, second straight practice miss. Ja'Kobi Lane (fractured wrist) on IR. If Flowers out, Ravens WR hierarchy: 1. Rashod Bateman 2. Devontez Walker 3. LaJohntay Wester 4. Elijah Sarratt 5. Chris Moore.
items.why: Re-aggravated hamstring Week 1 after big half (5-150-1); consecutive DNPs; day-to-day per coach.
items.implication: Likely lean OUT or limited vs NO; thins BAL WR corps significantly with Lane IR.
items.opportunity: Snaps/routes/targets for Bateman primary; Andrews/Henry more involved.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (Houston Chronicle); history of missing 5 games on hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI; Grade 1 strain, DNP Thursday, status in jeopardy for Sunday vs CIN. Ran 37 of 42 routes last week.
items.why: Hamstring strain during practice; doctors don't believe serious but availability jeopardized; soft-tissue history.
items.implication: High risk of missing W2; if OUT, major target vacuum in HOU offense.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Xavier Hutchinson, Kayshon Boutte, Jaylin Noel, Dalton Schultz.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS: Averaged 21.3 PPG home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TD passes W1. DAL top-5 implied total (27) in high-total game (50.5). Smash spot despite W1.
items.why: Elite home splits + soft WAS secondary + game script/total.
items.opportunity: Pass volume, TDs in shootout potential.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson: 'I'm ready to go.' Unclear how much he earns at expense of Rhamondre Stevenson, but returning at right time—Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown (ankle) on IR; nice matchups ahead (PIT, JAX, BUF, LV, NYJ, CHI, MIA, GB, DET) before Week 11 bye.
items.why: Healthy return timing + Brown IR creates playmaker vacuum; schedule soft stretch.
items.implication: Potential committee expansion or lead if Stevenson limited; stash/handcuff value rises.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, explosive plays vs Stevenson; goal-line TBD.
items.conflict: Still secondary until proven volume over Stevenson.

items.text: For second straight day, Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP due to rib injury; unlikely available Sunday vs Raiders. Brock Bowers also DNP again post knee surgery.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; consecutive full DNPs, working with trainers only.
items.implication: High probability OUT for W2; hurts LAC passing volume/efficiency.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes for Quentin Johnston, Tre' Harris (ETR beneficiary), other LAC WRs/TEs.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: Handled 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), targeted on 40% routes (tied team lead, 24% share overall). Indy just gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.why: Dominant Week 1 usage in KC debut + soft matchup vs leaky IND run D.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan league lead). 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Overreaction to prior injury scare.
items.why: Elite Week 1 util under Kubiak + consistent receiving role.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; averages 93 yds/18.0 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI D allowed >10 YPT to CAR WRs last week.
items.why: Massive share with Wentz + historical production + soft CHI secondary.

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers highlight injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre' Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown=Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara=Kendre Miller. Also Deebo Samuel etc. as adds. Projections/Thorman ranks/ROS Top-150 live.
items.why: Direct role expansion from listed injuries/IR.
items.implication: Priority adds for depth/handcuffs in affected backfields/WR rooms.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: Back in after tough W1; 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT, 3 deep looks. TEN allowed 85% catch/16 YPR to Jets; 6th-most PPG to WRs since last year.
items.why: Strong underlying usage + juicy TEN matchup for deep/volume.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share Week 1, ran 8 more routes than Gainwell, every RB red-zone touch. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC. RB9 util score.
items.why: Clear lead role expansion in passing/red-zone over Gainwell + soft CLE matchup.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rush attempts W1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role further; NO 8.5-pt underdogs bad rushing script.
items.why: Committee + Kamara return + negative game script vs strong BAL.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero red-zone looks. SEA allows 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs since last season.
items.why: Anemic usage + tough SEA secondary matchup.
items.implication: Avoid/start only if desperate; stash concerns in shallow leagues.
corroboration: ETR note on Bourne impacting MHJ
